title: Specifying a Domain Controller for Scanning

blocks.text: After you configure an Active Directory (AD) domain for scanning, you can specify a domain controller or an LDAP server to be used for scanning. Domain Controller (DC) is a server responsible for security authentication requests through LDAP. You can connect your AD domain to Zscaler ITDR through a DC server or an LDAP authentication.
To specify a DC or LDAP server for scanning:

blocks.item: Go to ITDR > Manage > Active Directory Posture.
Locate the AD domain that you want to configure, and click the Edit icon.
In the Scan Agents Details window, for Logon Server, specify the DC or LDAP server to use for scanning.
